nodes.label: Renderer Bench Harness (bench.html)
nodes.rationale: Loads the scene once per mode (the engine's sorted renderer, then the opt-in stochastic renderer), sets each camera pose, and measures every variant with the engine's GPU timestamp profiler while a MessageChannel pump drives frames as fast as the GPU takes them, so the queue stays saturated regardless of vsync or tab visibility. Stochastic frames are diffed against the sorted frame at the same pose and against a second stochastic frame with another seed for the noise floor; three round-robin rounds per pose with median-of-medians and min-of-mins.

nodes.label: toSnapshot
nodes.rationale: Accepts the debug panel's window.getCameraState snapshot shape, or converts {position, target, fov} the way Camera.look does (see src/core/math.ts vecToAngles).

nodes.label: pump / pumpFrame
nodes.rationale: One frame sequenced as AppBase.tick does it, without waiting for the display; FRAMES_IN_FLIGHT=2 bounds queued frames because without a bound a phone's CPU runs hundreds of frames ahead and the profiler's reports for one variant arrive during the next; MessageChannel yields are used because timers in a hidden tab fire once a second at best.

nodes.label: attachProfiler
nodes.rationale: The engine's timestamp profiler reports asynchronously a few frames late and pass names live in pastFrameAllocations consumed by report(), so the report is wrapped to copy names and accumulate per-pass timings when they arrive.

nodes.label: capture
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not viewer.captureFrame(): that renders a query frame into its own target with a horizontal fov the temporal history would have to be resampled into, and it would enter the history as an extra sample. Instead one more frame is rendered and the canvas read back in the same task, because WebGPU keeps no drawing buffer past it.

nodes.label: imageDiff
nodes.rationale: The 8/255 changed-pixel threshold is the editor's convention; a separate 48-level far threshold catches ghosts and gross errors that the rms spreads over the whole image; the signed per-channel mean exposes intensity or tint bias.

nodes.label: depthRoughness
nodes.rationale: Mean absolute step of the 24-bit log depth view between neighbouring covered pixels - a depth surface's roughness, where plates show as steps.

nodes.label: flythrough / flyPath
nodes.rationale: A first pass streams the path's detail in (kept as the cold pass), then round-robin timed passes so drift touches each variant alike; the per-frame median over passes is the headline so a one-frame hitch in one pass does not move it; pathHold times the same views moving and still; keyframes follow a Catmull-Rom spline with unwrapped yaw.

nodes.label: orbitStep
nodes.rationale: A moving camera exercises the work-buffer colour refresh, LOD changes, the occlusion cull's reprojection and the temporal history; strafe motion moves sideways at the orbit's speed at the focus so the parallax uncovers what the foreground hid.

nodes.label: overdrawPath
nodes.rationale: Reads the projected cache back and sums its quads in pixels over the screen's, clipped where alpha falls below the clip as both renderers draw them; with the cull off the cache holds every splat the sorted renderer draws.

nodes.label: measure
nodes.rationale: Console markers around the measured frames support a host sampling GPU hardware counters alongside; timestamps come in 65.5 us ticks, so the mean over many frames resolves differences smaller than one tick that the median and minimum cannot.

nodes.label: captureStore (IndexedDB)
nodes.rationale: A run's worth of 1080p frames is far beyond localStorage, so save=/against= captures live in IndexedDB; a variant accumulates the same seeds each run, so diffing against an earlier build's tag shows an unchanged renderer differing by nothing.
